metadata.title: Adaptive GRC and AI Assurance Engine

components.title: Adaptive GRC and AI Assurance Engine
components.description: Context scoping, automated collectors, deterministic tests, OPA policies, six-state decisions, and integrity-protected evidence packaging.

control-implementations.description: Reference implementation statements for automated monitoring.

implemented-requirements.description: Collectors execute on a scheduled cadence, calculate control status, and publish sanitized telemetry for continuous monitoring.
Control executions produce timestamped evidence records and SHA-256 digests; raw records are packaged into immutable GitHub Releases.
